editorial.blurb: DaNang Kitchen captures the soul of authentic Vietnamese cuisine with impeccable technique and warmth that makes you feel like family.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Vietnamese egg coffee—reviewers consistently call it the best they've had—and pair it with the pork chop with sunny-side egg (Cơm Tấm Sườn Nướng) for a complete experience of their signature style.
signatureDishes: Pork chop with sunny-side egg (Cơm Tấm Sườn Nướng)
